YOUTHS.—1, Maclean, 26.22; 2, Adams, 26.30; 3, Godfrey, 26.35; 5, Simpson, 26.50; 8, Greene, 26.58; 9, Courtney, 27.10; 13, Cornell, 27.58; 15, Rice, 28.0; 16, Butt, 28.20; 19, Udall, 28.41; 21, Macklin, 29.10; 22, Jones, 33.30.

We hope Bergvalds will get better support and look to Arthur Allen and Dennis Childs for this, as we cannot expect Bill Sutton to go on for ever. Murray and Cornell should show improvement in the Shot. The Javelin was last year one of our weakest events.
After a mile he was still amongst the leaders and a little later began to force the pace on Lewis(Woodford), Stacey(T.V.H.) and Cornell(Chelmsford).
